title: finding(console,tests): `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx` fails intermittently in `Test (shard 2/8)` — the route-table render can outlast `findByPlaceholderText`'s default timeout while the console connects to its data source
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a test defect with a named site and two reproductions in CI (class a: a required check fails on changes that do not touch it, and in the merge queue it knocks unrelated PRs out). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from a CI diagnosis on PR objectui#10644, which does not touch this file. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main`)

`apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx`, added by PR objectui#10632 (objectui#10591, merged `eca276070` at 13:27Z). The `it.each` case "the standalone developer/api-console route honours the preset" renders the full console through its route table (`renderConsoleAt(...)`), then `await screen.findByPlaceholderText('/api/v1/...')` with the default `findBy*` timeout.

## Failures (CI logs read by the seat's diagnosis; ⛔ not reproduced locally)

- PR objectui#10644, run `36143553512`, job `108098969809` (`Test (shard 2/8)`), head `cab28b4`: `TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an element with the placeholder text of: /api/v1/...`. The attached DOM is the console boot screen ("Initializing application… / Connecting to data source"), so the API console's input never mounted. `Test Files 1 failed | 456 passed (457)`.
- Merge-queue run `36142794712` (head `6b6fd885c`, 13:43Z): the identical failure, same test, same line.
- Control: the same shard PASSED on the other merge-queue runs since the test landed (`36141059634`, `36142226812`, `36142228917`, `36143484980`). ⇒ intermittent, not deterministic.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

"Flake" is not the root cause. The mechanism reads as a render path whose readiness depends on the console's data-source connection step, awaited through a default-timeout query. Make readiness explicit: resolve the boot's connection deterministically in the test harness, or await the boot to finish before the `findBy*`. A bare timeout raise is the weaker fix and should say why. Check the sibling cases in the same file for the same shape.
